title.zh-CN: 早产儿置管后呼吸恶化 · 7日龄女性
title.en: Respiratory deterioration after catheter placement in a preterm infant · 7-day-old female

summary.zh-CN: 围绕早产儿置管后呼吸恶化，比较现有证据、不同解释与下一步处理。
summary.en: Review the evidence, competing explanations and next steps for respiratory deterioration after catheter placement in a preterm infant.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 识别置管后呼吸恶化的机械性线索。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise mechanical clues after line-related deterioration.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 整合胸腹影像与胸水结果。
learningOutcomes.en: Integrate imaging and pleural fluid findings.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 提出新生儿团队安全处理与通路评估。
learningOutcomes.en: Propose safe neonatal and vascular-access assessment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 明确乳糜胸及导管损伤证据边界。
learningOutcomes.en: Define the evidence limits for chylothorax and catheter injury.

question.en: What is the main problem today?

answer.zh-CN: 孩子呼吸越来越费力，颜色也发紫。
answer.en: The baby’s breathing worsened and she became blue.

answer.zh-CN: 出生后就气促，置管第 5 天又明显恶化。
answer.en: Breathing difficulty began after birth and worsened markedly on catheter day five.

name.zh-CN: 调阅 PICC 胸片记录

zh-CN: 调阅 PICC 胸片记录

text.zh-CN: 导管末端在第 3 胸椎下缘，后续胸片称位置同前；未提供血管造影证明漏点。
text.en: The tip was at the lower T3 level and later films described unchanged position; no venographic leak point was demonstrated.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 双侧胸腔积液伴肺不张，超声示右侧更多并有少量腹水。
text.en: Bilateral effusions with atelectasis, greater on the right by ultrasound, plus a small amount of ascites.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 淡黄透明，乙醚试验阳性，李凡他阴性；培养阴性。未列甘油三酯或乳糜微粒。
text.en: Clear pale-yellow fluid, positive ether test and negative Rivalta; cultures negative. Triglycerides and chylomicrons were not supplied.

source.zh-CN: 原报告病例资料；去标识化事实摘要，对话为教学改写。
source.en: Source report, case presentation; de-identified factual summary with educational dialogue.

text.zh-CN: 原报告胸穿、拔 PICC 后胸水及腹水消退，转回 CPAP，住院 54 天体重 2.4 kg 出院；2、4 个月随访生长发育报告正常。
text.en: Following drainage and PICC removal, pleural fluid and ascites resolved and support returned to CPAP. Discharge occurred after 54 days at 2.4 kg; growth/development were reported normal at two and four months.

text.zh-CN: 导管相关胸水/外渗或淋巴损伤，原报告诊断乳糜胸
text.en: Catheter-related effusion/extravasation or lymphatic injury; the report labelled chylothorax

feedback.zh-CN: 时序及后续去除导管反应提示关联，但机制仍需核对。
feedback.en: Timing and subsequent response to line removal suggest association, with mechanism requiring clarification.

text.zh-CN: 仅靠阴性培养就排除所有感染
text.en: Negative culture excludes every infection

feedback.zh-CN: 阴性培养不能作绝对排除。
feedback.en: Negative cultures are not absolute exclusion.

text.zh-CN: 只考虑早产本身，不评估导管
text.en: Attribute everything to prematurity without checking the catheter

feedback.zh-CN: 新发生胸腹水需要解释。

prompt.zh-CN: 呼吸恶化时应怎样组织处理？

need.zh-CN: 请先核对相应病史和这一阶段的原始记录。
need.en: First review the relevant history and source records available in this phase.

text.zh-CN: 新生儿团队立即评估呼吸循环、积液及可疑导管并规划安全引流/替代通路
text.en: The neonatal team urgently evaluates breathing, circulation, effusions and the line, with safe drainage/access planning

feedback.zh-CN: 不能只不断加大通气而不处理机械或导管因素。
feedback.en: Escalating ventilation alone misses mechanical or line-related factors.

text.zh-CN: 照抄每次 20–30 mL 给所有体重婴儿
text.en: Copy 20–30 mL drainage for infants of any weight

feedback.zh-CN: 病例抽液量不是普遍剂量。
feedback.en: Case drainage volume is not a universal dose.

text.zh-CN: 保持可疑输液不变直到培养阳性
text.en: Continue the suspect infusion unchanged until cultures turn positive

feedback.zh-CN: 这忽视非感染性导管风险。

prompt.en: How strong is the chylothorax evidence?

feedback.zh-CN: 乙醚试验与导管时序不能独立区分所有原因。
feedback.en: The ether test and timing alone do not distinguish every mechanism.

text.zh-CN: 已证明胸导管穿孔
text.en: Thoracic duct perforation is proven

feedback.zh-CN: 未展示漏点或直接损伤。
feedback.en: No leak point or direct injury is shown.

text.zh-CN: 拔管后改善证明无需随访
text.en: Improvement after removal eliminates follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 仍需评估呼吸、营养与生长。
feedback.en: Respiration, nutrition and growth still need review.

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 以通俗语言说明主要判断、下一步及至少一项具体未知，询问理解和顾虑；不得声称未载明的疗效或预后。
judgeGuidance.en: Use plain language for the interpretation, next step and at least one case-specific uncertainty; check understanding and concerns, without asserting undocumented benefit or prognosis.

knowledge.zh-CN: 先区分病史、检查和推论；指出不确定性。后续经过须在完成当前决策后查阅。
knowledge.en: Distinguish history, findings and inference, and state uncertainty. The subsequent course is reviewed after completing the current decisions.

conclusion.zh-CN: 导管相关胸腹水造成呼吸恶化；原报告称乳糜胸，但直接机制和现代脂质确证不足。
conclusion.en: Catheter-associated pleural/abdominal fluid accompanied respiratory deterioration; the source called it chylothorax, with incomplete mechanistic and lipid confirmation.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 置管后的新变化需重新评估导管。
keyReasoning.en: Reassess a catheter after new deterioration.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 病例引流量不能作为通用处方。
keyReasoning.en: Case-specific drainage volume is not a general prescription.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 诊断标签与确证证据分开。
keyReasoning.en: Separate diagnostic labels from confirmatory evidence.

boundaries.zh-CN: 单例回顾不能证明因果或比较疗效。数字仅为原报告时点记录，不是实时监测；没有参考区间的数据不自行补区间。
boundaries.en: A single retrospective report cannot establish causality or comparative efficacy. Numbers are source time-point records, not live monitoring; missing reference intervals are not invented.
